title: The 3 Best Wine Coolers and Fridges for Red and White Wine
h1: The 3 Best Wine Coolers and Fridges for Red and White Wine
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for wine coolers and fridges for red and white wine, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at wine coolers and fridges for red and white wine using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: EdgeStar CWB2886FD 28 Bottle Wine and Beverage Cooler
products.blurb: Key specs: Independently controlled left and right zones, Left zone 40°F to 65°F, right zone 38°F to 65°F, French doors with UV-resistant glass.
strengths: Fully independent zone thermostats hold the widest and most reliable temperature gap between compartments on this list
UV-resistant glass on both doors protects both red and white equally
28-bottle capacity is enough to keep a real stock of both styles simultaneously
limitations: Higher price than a freestanding dual-zone unit of similar capacity
Requires a built-in cabinet cutout, not a simple counter placement
Overkill for a household that mostly drinks one style
features: Independently controlled left and right zones
Left zone 40°F to 65°F, right zone 38°F to 65°F

products.name: NewAir 24 Bottle Wine Cooler Refrigerator French Door
products.blurb: Key specs: 24-bottle dual-zone capacity, 41°F to 64°F digital range per zone, French door with double-layer tempered glass.
strengths: 41°F to 64°F range comfortably covers both correct red and correct white storage temperatures
French doors give quick access to whichever zone you need without opening the whole cabinet
Widely reviewed with a strong track record for holding its set temperature
limitations: Zone divider is fixed, so the ratio of upper to lower zone space can't be adjusted
24 bottles fills up quickly once split roughly in half between two styles
features: French door with double-layer tempered glass

products.name: NutriChef 33 Bottle Dual Zone Wine Fridge
products.blurb: Key specs: 33-bottle dual-zone capacity, 41°F to 64°F adjustable range, Built-in circulation fan.
strengths: 33-bottle total capacity means each zone can comfortably hold a real stock without crowding
Circulation fan helps each zone recover temperature faster after the door opens
Digital display makes it easy to confirm both zones independently
limitations: Fewer long-term reliability reports than NewAir or EdgeStar
Zone split is fixed, similar to most units in this price range
Freestanding cabinet is bulkier than a similarly priced compressor unit

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
